name: Loving You in My Final Days
original_name: Loving You in My Final Days
overview: She pretended to betray the man she loved to hide a terminal illness. A year later, he returns as a billionaire CEO—with another woman by his side and nothing but resentment for her. Every reunion reopens old wounds, while the truth remains buried between them. When love was built on one heartbreaking lie, can the truth still bring them back together?
